applicabilityBasis.summary: USDG is a MAS-regulated U.S. dollar stablecoin with 1:1 redemption through Paxos Digital Singapore and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.notes: The June 18, 2026 review identified Paxos Digital Singapore and Paxos Issuance Europe Oy as USDG issuers and located no token-specific U.S. GENIUS authorization. On October 1, 2026, current Paxos terms again identified PDS/PIE as joint USDG issuers. The OCC's December 12, 2025 Paxos Trust conversion decision expressly requires a separate written non-objection before that bank offers, markets, issues or makes USDG available through its multi-jurisdictional platform; the charter alone does not establish USDG authorization. A scoped review of that decision, OCC Bulletin 2026-3, the OCC digital-assets licensing inventory and Paxos terms, plus an OCC-site USDG/PDS search, located no public USDG-specific PPSI approval, pending GENIUS application or foreign-issuer registration. The inventory is not exhaustive and excludes conversion application documents; this negative search does not establish that no approval exists or that no issuer has been approved. Historical reserve-report review reference retained from the June review: 2026-04-30, date kind unspecified.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The October 1 scoped review located no public USDG-specific PPSI approval, pending GENIUS application or foreign-issuer registration. Paxos terms identify PDS/PIE as joint issuers. The Paxos Trust charter decision requires a separate USDG non-objection; no such determination was located. The licensing inventory is limited and this search is not an exhaustive absence claim.
